offering_description.value: Provides online and campus-based postsecondary degree programs to adult learners, many of them military service members, veterans and public servants. Students enroll in courses and earn certificates and degrees, with tuition paid by students, employers or military tuition assistance programs.

primary_services.value: undergraduate degree programs; graduate degree programs; professional certificates; nursing education; career training

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult learners pursuing degrees and certificates for career advancement; B2G: military service members and veterans using federal tuition assistance benefits

end_markets.value: higher education; military and defense; public safety; healthcare

revenue_model.value: service fees: tuition and fees paid by students, employers or military tuition assistance programs

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers degree and certificate instruction to students, sold to individuals, employers and military programs; software / platform: operates online learning platform for remote course delivery to students nationwide

geography_served.value: US national: Students enrolled from all US states, plus some campus locations in several states and international online students

specialization.value: related lines: online university programs and campus-based nursing and career schools serving adult learners

distribution_channels.value: online: fully online courses delivered over the internet to students nationwide; own locations: campus-based nursing and career training schools in several states; direct sales: admissions advisors enrolling students directly, including military education offices

regulatory_exposure.value: high: accreditation and state licensing required, Title IV federal student aid rules enforced by the U.S. Department of Education

notes: Specific campus locations, program mix and business segments may have changed; details are based on general knowledge and may be incomplete.
